title: EDGE-021-responsible-leaderboard-extension
universal_lens: The responsible leaderboard extension is modeled as a constrained optimization over a high-dimensional state space. The system enforces a zero-measure boundary condition on financial and privacy variables, ensuring the trajectory of the application remains strictly within a safe, deterministic subspace devoid of stochastic gambling dynamics.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this maps to a conformal prediction framework where the risk envelope is set to absolute zero. Bayesian priors for any real-money or live-sportsbook integration are assigned infinite penalty weights, guaranteeing that posterior predictive distributions collapse entirely onto the null hypothesis of synthetic, sandboxed data.
gse_mapping: For GSE situational reasoning, this defines a strict Markov Decision Process (MDP) with hard absorbing states. Any transition attempting to activate deposits, payouts, or unauthorized friend-data imports triggers an immediate veto operator, forcing the system into a disabled-by-default quarantine state to preserve structural integrity.

primitives.name: Financial Null Boundary Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not launch paid contests, prizes, deposits, payouts, live leaderboards, sportsbook/DFS affiliate flows, or real-money entries without founder/legal approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: F: Financial transaction vector (dimensionless boolean flags). \mathcal{A}: Approval scalar (0 or 1).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes all monetary vectors default to zero unless explicitly overridden by a cryptographic legal signature.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the authorization matrix \mathcal{A} is compromised or if implicit value exchange occurs outside the defined ledger.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a Dirichlet boundary condition in PDEs, fixing the financial potential to exactly zero across the entire domain.
layer2.telemetry: Audit logs verifying zero-value initialization of all prize and deposit fields.

primitives.name: Consent Data Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not import real friend-history data without explicit consent and deletion controls.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: D_{real}: Real-world social graph tensor. C: Explicit consent boolean mask. \Delta: Deletion control operator.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the existence of a robust, cryptographically verifiable consent mechanism prior to any data ingestion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities arise if D_{real} is ingested when C=0, or if \Delta fails to asymptotically erase data upon revocation.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a sparse masking kernel in GSI inference pipelines, actively zeroing out unconsented nodes in the adjacency matrix.
layer2.telemetry: Database query latency and row-count verification post-deletion.

primitives.name: Synthetic State Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - No production data or real friend data is used.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_{prod}: Production dataset. S_{mock}: Mock/synthetic dataset. \epsilon: Tolerance threshold for data leakage.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes perfect isolation between the staging environment and the production database clusters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violated if any element of S_{prod} leaks into the testing manifold, causing \epsilon > 0.

layer2.mapping: Represents a topological isolation constraint in GSE, ensuring the testing manifold is completely disconnected from the production metric space.
layer2.telemetry: Schema validation checks and hash comparisons against known production data fingerprints.
